reviews.text:
All other Banfield pet hospitals I’ve been to (in Staten Island, New Jersey, and Long Island) you get to go back with your dog so you can talk to the vet and show them the concerns on your dog. This was my dogs first visit at this location to ‘establish care’ since I’ve moved to Brooklyn and wanted to make our lives easier by going to a Banfield in Brooklyn. You don’t get to go back with your dog which doesn’t make sense if this was our first visit to establish care which they make a big deal if you need to pick up medicine. How can you build a relationship with my dog and I if I don’t get to go back there with him to discuss him and what’s going on.
Makes no sense. I also don’t trust what’s going on if I can’t actually see what you’re doing.
I suggest going to any other Banfield.

Also had to wait more than an hour after my appointment to be seen so if you’re someone that works plan to call in late.
They are all very happy good. I love their service.

If I would give Benfield Pet Hospital on 238 Atlantic Ave minus 5 stars I would. They confirmed appointment a week ago. I paid 40$ for uber to get there. When my son arrived there with our dog they said there is no appointment they change it without letting us know but claimed they texted and text didn't go through. When I called customer service I was put on hold for 30 minutes. After finally i got to speak to customer service rep there was loud laughs on the background making t hard to hear the rep. They were able to give appointment that day two hours later, but even then we have to wait an hour to be checked in. after that the hospital employee claimed my  payment card is not there  ( we set up everything before it was there) until another employee didn't come and found the card on file . It supposed to be first time charge and insurance would start every month after that but they charged like a would have come without insurance. The amount is wrong . I set up insurance before scheduling appointment. The initial charge supposed to be 109$ they charged 238$.
I wouldn't recommend anybody to come to this place. This place is a mess and it looks like people coming here to get free service Insurance is not cheap either. Never ever get this insurance and don't go to this place. Be aware of this place. Save your time. energy and money
Nightmare experience. Never again.

I truly cannot believe it’s resorted to posting a poor review online, but my experience with this Banfield is inexcusable. I have made sure to use Banfield for my dogs as they have several locations in states we have lived in for continuity of care. This location is wildly unprofessional. The communication is nonexistent. For one, they lost one of my dogs records? They cannot tell me the last time she got her heartworm shot, which is pretty important. Secondly, during our yearly visit where we made it clear that we wanted to get both dogs up to date on all shots and vaccines, they do the heartworm test but fail to tell us that they are due for their shot (we did not know because their records were lost) OR talk to us about any other heartworm preventative. Instead, I realized the same day that it was missed and called. I was lied to over the phone saying that they did bring it up (they absolutely did not) and that we now have to pay a room fee for them to go back and get the heart worm shot. Today, we go back and pay the fee to get them both back up to date on heart worm medication. Both on the phone AND in person, my husband lets them know we want the yearly shot. I just checked my bill and they were both given the six month shot. When we called them to ask why they did that when we specifically let them know several times that we wanted the yearly one, they were dismissive and stated they “only had the six month shot” and that they “would have told us”. They did not. I am beyond disappointed in the communication and professionalism of this vet and will absolutely not be returning. If you can find another vet, do so.
I love how easy Banfield is. Dr. Martinez is amazing and really takes the time to get to know you and your pet!

Do not visit this location. The cops were called on me because I asked for information to make a complaint. I made an appointment for my Ill senior dog and they canceled 30 minutes before and I was already there in 90 degree weather. They Wouldn't accommodate me or give me information to make a complaint. Dominique the manager called the cops on me. I asked if she would rather call the cops on me instead of giving me the information to make a complaint and she said YUP! I sent a email to Banfield and I have yet to hear back from anyone. Next I'm taking it to the media

They over charged me and they dislocated my dogs knee cap they gave him vaccines without my permission and they took my dog last week for teeth cleaning had him for 4 hours no eating or drinking since the night before, they decided to not do his cleaning due to the fact that I hung up on the supervisor name Linda that I had never got along with. The staff there makes it bad for the doctors but the doctors ain’t shit either. Dr Martinez was my dogs doctor and she did something to his knee cap without my permission while he was sedated for a teeth cleaning and came out with knee cap popping out. And his ribs had looked swollen like if he fell or dropped him. They over charged me and they said they don’t want me coming there anymore they still charged my card today and they never gave me back my money. I been calling them for 3 days now and they place you on hold and never come back. THIS PLACE NEEDS TO BE SHUT DOWN. On one occasion I went they killed a ladies cat and she was crying in the wait area due to
The fact they gave her cat something without her permission I heard the whole conversation and I was so mad for
Her. I will be calling News 12 on them today. I reached out to
The CEO of Banfield they don’t reach back this place is horrible and they’re over charging as well.
This vet killed my friends cat via an anesthesia incident during one of their highly marketed routine dental cleanings. Do NOT go here. They want your money and nothing else

I made a same-day appointment online for June 26th and had my appointment confirmed via email. While I was on my way to the clinic they told me that my appointment had been canceled because the timing didn't match what was already in their system. My dog is suffering from an eye infection and I made an appointment via the appropriate channels; now they're telling me I have to wait until after July 4th for my dog to see a vet. On their website they clearly have times still available.
We're so glad you had a great experience! We’ll make sure to pass this on to our Brooklyn location. Thanks for partnering with us for your pet's needs. 🐾 …

I’ve been going to Banfield since my almost 13 year old dog was a few months old. They have always taken good care of him. He’s had several different vets over the years as you can imagine, and they have all been great, but the best one has been Dr. Martinez. I always tell people that she is literally one of the best doctors I have ever encountered, both for humans and animals. She is extremely caring, knowledgeable and clearly loves what she does. She takes the time to explain things thoroughly, answer questions you may have and makes you feel comfortable. Her bedside manner is top tier and she has an amazing personality too. She goes the extra mile when providing services to her patients (and their parents). She is always helpful but there was a specific time that my appointment wasn’t in the system due to a mishap with the call center that scheduled it and there was a chance I couldn’t be seen. I was extremely upset due to the appointment being one I had made since my pup had a really bad cough. Well, Dr. Martinez saw me sitting in the waiting area when she arrived that morning and inquired as to what was going on. Despite her having a full schedule, she squeezed me in immediately and was able to tell me what was going on as well as treat my little guy. She showed the utmost care and sensitivity when I had my own moment about his new diagnosis. She truly is amazing human being and my dog (and I) are blessed to have her as a medical provider.
Hi there - Paws down, we have the best clients! Thank you for your review!
Wonderful care about my dear cat Frank :)

Their website is garbage, I've spent hours looking for veterinarian offices that have offer full diagnostic services for my dog who is having complications from a heart murmur that needs to be seen ASAP for an ECG and they lied on their website about appointment availability. I booked an appointment for tomorrow at 11AM and received a phone call from them teling me that they can't see my dog. Prior to all of this, I was going to enroll in their Wellness Plan but you know what? I do not recommend them.

HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE 1ST OF ALL I WAS ON HOLD FOR ABOUT 45 MINS I WAS ASKING FOR REPLACEMENT RABIES TAGS BECAUSE THEY WERE MISPLACED!  I WAS EVEN WILLING TO PAY !!!!I AM A PET PARENT OF 3 DOGS IM PAYING FOR THE WELLNESS PLAN NO DISCOUNT IS OFFERED FOR MULTIPLE DOGS YOU CANT GET AN APPOINTMENT WITHIN THE SAME WEEK AND I WAS TOLD THAT I HAVE TO GO BACK TO THE ORGINAL LOCATION ALL THE WAY IN PELHAM WHICH IS A TOTAL INCONVENIENCE.  I AM SO LOOKING FOR ANOTHER PLACE FOR PET CARE FOR MY GIRLS BECAUSE THIS RIDICULOUS!  I AM NOT THE TYPE OF PERSON TO COMPLAIN I ONLY SIGNED THEM UP BECAUSE MY DAUGHTER WAS OK WITH THE LEVEL OF SERVICE SHE RECIVES UP THERE BUT THE BROOKLYN LOCATION..SO I GUESS BROOKLYN ISNT CONNECTED TO PELHAM...
The service great except I told the person at the desk to send my by. email which I have not received  so far, but otherwise everything was great. Thanks
Rhonda - We're so glad you had a great experience! We’ll make sure to pass this on to our Brooklyn location. Thanks for partnering with us for your pet’s needs. 🐾 …

I’m disappointed with my recent experience. I had a 9:30 AM drop-off scheduled for my dog and decided to arrive early at 9:00 AM. When I got there, there were already six people ahead of me. Despite waiting in line for 45 minutes, only one person had been called by the time my appointment arrived. When I left, there were four more people behind me waiting.

What’s the point of scheduling drop-offs if it’s this disorganized? They clearly over-schedule and don’t respect their clients’ time. I expected much better.

--
They called me today (6/5/2026) to confirm the appt for next week and they changed the time without notifying me prior and the excuse was that they don't have control of the time you can select online. Don't know how they are still in business.

Listen to the 1 star reviews! I had the worst experience with this Bansfield location. I booked a next-day appointment via the app, turns out that this location’s system is completely disconnected from the main Bansfield and the appointment did not exist. If this is a regular occurrence for people, which it seems like it is from other reviews that I read after my experience, then they should really be clear of that in the location description and work to fix any discrepancies in scheduling asap.

Instead of letting me know via phone call, text or email that my appointment was cancelled/non-existent, I trekked all the way down there (about an hour away from me since they closed the upper Manhattan location) only for them to tell me my appointment didn’t exist and that they tried to call me (they didn’t). After I showed them on my phone that I didn’t receive any calls at the time they claimed they called, they proceeded to catch an attitude and didn’t apologize. Even if they did call me (which they did not), the staff could have left a voicemail, sent an email, or even a text to cancel if they assumed I didn’t answer. This whole experience was completely unprofessional and a waste of my time. Would not recommend!

Great in person service, less than subpar customer service on the phone.

I was held back by work so I called 1 hour before closing to get my cat's prescription transferred. Instead I was left on hold for nearly 40 minutes and they hung up on me without explanation.

I called again and I was connected in under 5 minutes by a staff that seemed annoyed I even called. They then told me its too late to transfer the prescription. When I asked whether its safe to wait, they just said they can't do anything with no other reccomendation provided.

It seems like I mean nothing to them. I'll just take my business and pet somewhere that actually values customers and saving lives.

If i could give the Banfield Pet Hospital on Atlantic Ave in Brooklyn, NY 0 stars I would. The first time I came, they couldn’t find my appointment even though I had already been rescheduled via a phone call after initially making the appointment online. Their system was down and it didn’t catch new patients. Fine.

I come back one week later during the scheduled time made in person and they say it will be a 30-45minute wait. Again, fine, but you could at least call and give me a heads up before I come all the way in in the middle of my workday. Terrible terrible terrible. Will never come back here.

We brought our Pug in for a check up and subsequently, he needed multiple RXs after his visit. As the non-primary caretaker, fulfilling prescription meds for a dog is not something I've done in the past, but I called Banfield and luckily Jasue answered the phone and helped with all my silly questions with patience and care. I was never made to feel silly or naive, and I never could have anticipated such a wonderful interaction, I'm so happy!

I can't thank you enough Jasue, you're a lifesaver and made this whole process so much easier. I'm bringing you muffins when I bring Frank in for his next check-up!

Don’t expect to be seen anywhere near your appointment time here. I’ve been a few times and each time, we wait a minimum of an hour after our appointment time to be seen, and often longer than an hour. Additionally, they market special appointments as “in-room” but you have to hand your pet off to them; you’re not in the room at all. They give zero apologies for being late or misleading appointment types. It’s a very “well it is what it is and you gotta be okay with it” attitude here.

I’ve been to other Banfield locations that have been great. Don’t waste your time going to this location.
Great service
The vets are great the staff are polite and very professional. They accommodate you when needed. I have 3 dogs at Banfield.
We’ve been coming here for 4 years since my dog was a pup. From the moment we show up, we’re treated warmly and with respect. Any questions we have are answered thoroughly.

The place is clean and good service. But they don’t allow pet owners in the check room as they use to. It is not as private as it was. The vet comes out to talk to you about your pet I front of everyone. It was more private before. They should use the rooms they have as they use to.

I’ve been with Banfield for little over 12 years and after moving to New York, I unfortunately had not had the best experiences until my visit to the Brooklyn location.
I want to sincerely thank Dr. Bailey Percival for her care. Yesterday was incredibly difficult as we discussed the quality of life of my sweet Penny, who has been rapidly declining and truly felt supported by her and her staff. Thank you again for your compassion and empathy ❤️‍🩹
Banfield has bad services when dealing with appointments the representative has a nasty attitude and wasn’t willing to accommodate my new pet visit and force me to go somewhere else

Dr. Martinez is the best. Been seeing her since i got my dog and Shes so sweet with my puppy. Bella doesnt love the vet but I know shes in good hands with Dr. Martinez and the staff. It is a bit hard to schedule an urgent appointment but I still like this office. I def recommend the membership you will save in the long run and always have a doctor to take your dog too.
Thanks for the pawsitive review!
Hi Iris - Thanks for the 5 stars and for partnering with us for your pet’s health!
Excellent 👌🏻👍🏻 …

The service is terrible. They gave me an appointment for 4 pm, and at 4:20 pm I asked what time I would be seen.
They saw me at 4:43 pm.
They force you to have a 12-month plan, which they charge on time.
And once, when I arrived 5 minutes late, they refused to see me.
I don't recommend them.
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡🐾 …

"I had a great experience with this vet. They really took excellent care of my dog, and the staff was super kind and professional. I felt really confident in their care, and I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a vet."

When I made appointment online for 10:30 for in room visit and when I got there, they changed it. They said we have one at 12 if you wanna wait but I couldn’t wait and they said they were gonna clean his ears and they never did. You have to stay on top of these people make sure they do what they gotta do for your pet.
You've got us purring with your rating!  Thank you for choosing Banfield.

It’s the only Banfield hospital in brooklyn or it’s Queens or Staten Island. This makes this hospital efficient to represent Brooklanders! So I want to be fair the staff are great but PetSmart needs to do New Yorkers and Brooklyn BETTER!
Dr. Martinez was great good communication with Linda was also on point with informational regards to Mia, wise well informed. Also love pet Smart good variety of things to buy.

This place is awful. I've been coming here for almost 5 years amd it is getting progressively worse. I did not write this review sooner because Dr. MARTINEZ is the absolute best. However,  3 appts in a row I made appts with Dr. Martinez and instead it was another DR who saw my dog.

The front desk staff is understaffed, rude every single day and will waste your time. It is incredible how they are always behind like today that drop off was at 8 but no one came out to desks until 8:15am. Im here again for pick up at 5:10pm, its 5:40 and im still waiting. I can clearly see Dr. Martinez attended a bunch of other pets but not mine. The front desk staff will always try to upsell you but will not upgrade your plan the way they need to. Move you from register to register and get an attitude with you when you get upset. The entire front desk needs to be retrained.

I booked an appointment 2-3 weeks ago for early Jan, and just received a voicemail that the appointment slot was no longer available. No problem - called them back, lady on the call was really patient. Turns out their appointment system online is fake and completely not tied to their actual practice's system, next slot was 2 weeks out from the slot I requested, which wouldn't work for me since my dog's vaccines would have expired by then and she goes to doggy daycare regularly.

I had previously used Banfield in WA when I was moving to NYC, for a doctor's note for the airlines to bring my cat over and the slot I booked was the one I got.

Going back to just using Vetco, which has a really easy online booking system for both vet and grooming, and so far been very reliable.

This review is for both Banfield overall and specifically the Brooklyn location. I started with Banfield in 2006 with my first dog in California and added my second dog in 2012. The appointment availability and quality of care has substantially declined since I started with them almost 20 years ago. In 2020, after my first dog died in January, I was still required to pay for his plan for the full year through June which felt unusually cruel. Against my better judgment, I kept my second dog on the plan and we have consistently struggled to secure prompt appointments over the last 5 years. The last couple times my dog had a suspected UTI, the Brooklyn location couldn’t get us in for a week which defeats the purpose of having a plan like this. I won’t let my dog suffer in pain for a week because they no longer reserve blocks of time daily for illness and injury patients like they used to. I’ve had to go to other vets and pay out of pocket because of this. This is my last year as a Banfield customer.
WORST WORST PLACE TO STAY AWAY ,IVE BEEN PAYING THEM FOR MONTH AND NEVER USED THEM ,CAME IN WITH AN EMERGENCY AND THEY WOULD NOT SEE ME .... DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY FIND A DIFFERENT PLACE .

Amazing staff and Vetinarians. I feel like this hospital/clinic does not get the credit it deserves despite being overbooked and short staff. Everyone tries their hardest to accommodate everyone the best way they know how to. Me and my dog Washington appreciate you guys so much!

I’ve been going to this same Banfield for 10+ years, first with my family’s dog and then with my own. I’ve always had a good experience. The staff is friendly, the veterinarians are knowledgeable, and they seem to always be busy which I feel like speaks for itself. I’ve always felt my dogs were cared for. They explain everything so I can actually understand things and never made me feel weird about asking any questions. They remind you when your pet is due for something, the app is great and comes with 24/7 vet chat, plus it doesn’t hurt that they are conveniently located in the same store as where I buy my dog food and bring my dog for grooming. For me it’s affordable and the wellness plans actually cover a lot. I recommend Banfield often!

The doctors and staff here are always caring and accommodating to my pet.
They always explain everything to be done and to be done.
My dog is always happy after his visits.

Do yourself and your pet a favor and avoid this place. They have no sense of urgency. The vet Dr. Martinez does not follow up and there no continuity of care. My pet had been seen by multiple providers and it was clear that none of them reviewed previous records. They become very unhappy when you share your concerns. I was given a copy of my pets records with information that had never been discussed with me. The clinic manager Dominique is also unhelpful in resolving and addressing concerns. Infact so told me to take my very sick pet elsewhere and Dr. Martinez refused to meet with me after I paid for testing that was never explained or discussed with me. Terrible service!

If I could give it no stars I would. #2249 Brooklyn is the location I started with. However, since joining in February I am very disappointed they do not take walk in. What you may think is an emergency for your pet is not to them. I have emailed them pictures of what was wrong with my pet they said they would get back to me but never did. Today I reached out and was told they will review the picture and get back to me before close of day and no call back. The plans are just get our money because of i have a plan why should I have to go somewhere else and spend money when I'm paying for a plan every month. IT IS A WASTE OF TIME GOING TO BANFIELD!!! You have to go to different locations if you can luck up with an available appointment.  They need to be investigated by the better business bureau ASAP. Our pets could be died under their care. They do not care. No call backs, no appointments, long line when you do go I am sorry I take my pet there when its time to renew I will not be renewing.  BANFIELD are crooks. They need more vet doctors and staff. I shouldn't have to go to another brought when I reside in Brooklyn.
Today Nov. 6, after the review, corrective action was made but am not going to change the review because I shouldn't have to write a review like I did for such a established company. I hope BANFIELD listen to all the negative reviews and understand where we as pet parents are coming from. Thanks for the corrective action.

My dog is sick so I Booked an appointment online. Confirmed appointment through email. Just got a call the afternoon before the appointment that they had to move it out 2 weeks. Then they lied that they tried to call me sooner and it went to voicemail. I have no voicemails, so are you afraid to leave them?

This is not a trustworthy place to take your dog if they will just lie to you over nothing.

I came here because of their drop-off service, but the overall experience has been nothing but disappointment. This place seems extremely understaffed and the app is useless. The online schedule is NEVER accurate and I constantly get calls to reschedule (usually one or two weeks later than what shows on their app). It’s horrible when your pet is sick because how hard it is to schedule. As a lot of people mentioned, sometimes they schedule you for 8:30 but the store isn’t even open until 9! When you call, it’s common to be put on hold for 5-10 mins. Some staff is nice but some seems extremely unhappy because how busy they are. Banfield, you need to hire more staff for this location!!

The doctors are fine so far, but as my dog gets older and needs more care, I definitely need to change to a real vet.
Dr. Michelle Martinez is an excellent communicator and a wizard at navigating the international health certificate process. Would 100% go to her again.
You treated Rocko my puppy Boston Terrier with passion and care
understaffed and rude
Thanks for trusting us with your BFF 🧡 We appreciate the review! …

It's mostly an awesome time when I go
To Banfield with Apollo. At times it can be a long wait to be seen, but it's usually a nice experience.

I started with Banfield at their uptown location until they closed down and we were then relegated to the nearest hospital in Brooklyn. It's been such a downgrade in terms of service, communication, and care. The hours are inaccurate; I've arrived at 7:30 before to find that they are not open until 8-8:30, which is not ideal for working professionals. Even when I've called at 8, employees were not present to pick up until quarter after. It seems like they're incredibly understaffed so their employees are unhappy and unpleasant to deal with. When I am there, I get mixed messages from different employees. This place does not take walk INS like their other locations and the medication is not always readily available. I have their optimum wellness plan which does save some money, but at this point it isn't worth it. I've brought my pet in multiple times to pick up his heart worm medicine to then be told to come back another day when they have a single dose available because they refuse to break a 6 pack. Other times, the staff would tell us they don't know, and to call back later in the week. They have also said to leave a name and number for them to call back, which they never do. I also had mixed messages from the vet in terms of care, which my pet has suffered from. There doesn't seem to be any standards or regulations in place here, and the money that you do save with their plans is not worth the headache. It has been a consistently terrible experience every time I call or am there in person. I would not recommend this place.

I’m very nervous but relieved that both of my son’s will be visiting for the first time
Will be posting updates soon

Lady Amaterasu is always taken care of here. She has seen almost all the doctors and they always take their time with you to go over test results and answer any questions you may have. Thank you for always taking care of Lady Amaterasu

I’ve tried to give this Banfield location the benefit of the doubt time and time again, but my most recent visit was the final straw. This location is consistently short-staffed, the phones are never answered, and every visit comes with unreasonably long wait times.

Yesterday, I had a 10:00 AM appointment for my dog. After waiting in line for over an hour and change just to check him in, I was already frustrated. By 5:00 PM—seven hours later—he still had not been seen. The appointment was never completed, and I was sent home without the care my dog needed.

I’ve been patient and tried to keep my membership in hopes that things would improve, but it has been disappointment after disappointment. The lack of organization and efficiency at this location is unacceptable, and I will be canceling my membership. Our pets deserve better.

I’ve been a loyal Banfield member for years, but ever since moving to Brooklyn this location has been a nightmare and extremely unreliable. It’s nearly impossible to get anyone on the phone, I’m always stuck on hold for 10+ minutes and half the time no one even answers. In person, the service is just as bad: staff move incredibly slow, seem unhappy to be there, and the energy is terrible.

Every visit is a huge inconvenience. Dropping my dog off takes over an hour, and more than once I’ve been late to work because of their lack of urgency. Twice I showed up at opening time only to find the doors still locked because management overslept, even the employees were stuck waiting outside one of those times. Completely unprofessional and inconvenient.

To make matters worse, they constantly push overpriced food and medicine, exaggerating what my dog “needs” just to upsell me. It feels dishonest and money-driven, not about actual care.

I’m canceling my wellness plan because I can’t justify paying for benefits I dread using. I’ll be taking my dog to a real vet (GoodVets) one that may charge a bit more, but actually provides honest, efficient, convenient, competent, and caring service. I’d strongly recommend others do the same.
Thank you "fur" the review! 🐕 …
A big thank you for your pawsome review! 🐾 We hope to see you again soon. …

Ive been going here since my first pup was 1 i believe. I had 4 dogs go here.all taken care of well. Im down to 2 now Love the care they give my dogs the new staff shows they care the old staff can kick rocks. Still can improve on reception and calls and appintments But overall its great..im sorry for those who have had bad experiences. I only wish the best for everyones furbaby.thank you
Theyd get 5 stars if the appointments were easier to make and stop adding on the bill
We're grateful for your review of our pet hospital! Your positive experience motivates us to do even better. Feel free to let us know how we can make your pet's next visit exceptional.
Somehow the only one in like a two hour radius that does the EU health certs. Appreciated the helpfulness with this ordeal, it was horrible but not in a way that was the fault of anyone here lol.
Very good service
Everyone is so friendly and welcoming.
I received exceptional services for my boy My’ster, thanks Banfield team !
Woof-tastic! Thank you for the rating for our pet hospital. Your feedback is like treats for us! We're eager to make your pet's next visit just as tail-waggingly amazing.

Woof-tastic! Thank you for the 4-star rating for our pet hospital. Your feedback is like treats for us! We're eager to hear how we can make your pet's next visit tail-waggingly amazing.

Bad business. This location failed to explain the policy regarding charges related to early renewal, then proceeded to send the account to collections despite my inability to get in touch with anyone by phone. The wellness plan is similar to a 360 deal or a gym membership where they place hurdles to cancel. Even when you don’t render any services in the plan year, they use the contract that they fail to explain at check in, they send accounts to collections. The plan is not worth it!
You've got us purring with your rating! 😺 Thank you for choosing Banfield. …
A big thank you for your pawsome review! 🐾 We hope to see you again soon. …
Thanks for the paw-sitive review!
Absolutely rudest location I’ve ever dealt with
Amazing price s inside of a pet smart on atlantic ave in brooklyn they have everything for pets including grooming and training they also sell pets

The number of times I've been put on hold for more than 5 minutes is actually crazy. This morning alone I held for 20min. Most of the time they don't ask before putting you on hold, although the one time they DID ask I said Please Do Not and they put me on hold anyway without saying anything. Horrific customer service. At least check in with the people you're putting on hold?? Or like, say something?? I'm literally a vet receptionist lol

This place is an absolute joke. They are terrible with their customers and are completely unreliable. They mistreated our dog, called and said there was an emergency and to bring her immediately to a hospital for possible internal bleeding, and the animal hospital then notified it was only bruising (these bruises were NOT on her when we dropped her off). This cost us a ton of extra money, and when we called to cancel our plan, they made us wait 2-3 months before we had to call back for an answer of “we can’t do that, you have to call corporate”. All while continuing to charge us our monthly bill.

A completely pathetic excuse for a pet hospital and they should be ashamed of themselves and embarrassed in their customer support. After 6 years of service, we will never ever step into a Banfield again.
Dr. Su is the best! Highly recommended. They were very gentle to my cat even though she attempted to attack them.

I took my pup here for his second year of routine vaccinations, the same ones he had the year before at a different vet with no issues (which I now plan to return to). Shortly after receiving them at Banfield, he had a severe allergic reaction. I rushed him back in a panic, only to be met with little empathy and the added insult of being charged for the visit to treat the reaction they caused. Deeply disappointed by the lack of accountability and care.

We have been using Banfield Hospital for over a decade — loyal customers because of our dog, who sadly passed away unexpectedly. In the midst of grief, you start contacting services that are no longer needed. A wellness plan is no longer necessary for a pet that is no longer with us. It is disgraceful, predatory, and cruel to profit off the bodies of our deceased pets. What people fail to realize is that these are more than just pets — they are our family members.

When we questioned what services had been rendered since the beginning of the policy that would justify continued charges to our account, the agent simply repeated what they were trained to say: “Unfortunately, your plan is for a year, and you must either continue paying monthly or pay the entire balance up front.” Why not tell me what services my pet actually received to justify the cost?

Now, for the next few months, I either have to relive the death of my dog every time I see that charge — or take a financial hit and pay off the plan in full.

If you do anything, stay away from this company. Find a local hospital instead — because these large corporations are heartless and greedy.
